intervention: Yaw adds measured tool-X statistics and same frozen Transformer third prediction, targeting nearest world cardinal axis. Hold maintains native arm actuator position targets and pauses estimator updates during close/release/settle. Settle adds a 2 mm/.03 direction pre-grasp gate to hold. Baseline is exact E41 revision 3. No force, friction, final-scoring or model-weight change.
scope: Matched observed nine Panda placements, same homes/probes/budgets; no policy filtering or final-test evaluation.
